$comment: Canonical theme.json reference. Copy to config/theme.json, edit for your instance, and upload to the config bucket root. Colors, radii, and fonts map to --theme-* CSS variables in ui/src/index.css; content and asset fields map to InstanceConfig in ui/src/config/instance_config.ts. Omitted keys fall back to the shipped design tokens in ui/src/index.css. One instance, one file.

fonts.body: Google Sans Text, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif
